contentItem.title: 性质与证明：可公度量与中项无理线段与线段
contentItem.englishTitle: A straight line commensurable with that which produces with a medial area a medial whole is itself also a straight line which produces with a medial area a medial whole.

revision.changeSummary: Imported Heath source and machine-assisted Chinese draft. No mathematical or editorial review is implied.

surfaces.text: A straight line commensurable with that which produces with a medial area a medial whole is itself also a straight line which produces with a medial area a medial whole.
可公度线直线,以中项无理线段个区域生产中项无理线段个整体,其本身也是直线,以中项无理线段个区域生产中项无理线段个整体。（相关点与线段：A）

Let AB be a straight line which produces with a medial area a medial whole, and let CD be commensurable with AB; I say that CD is also a straight line which produces with a medial area a medial whole.
让AB成为直线,中项无理线段个区域中项无理线段个整数,CD区域可公度个整数;我说,CD区域中项无理线段个整数。

For let BE be the annex to AB, and let the same construction be made; therefore AE, EB are straight lines incommensurable in square which make the sum of the squares on them medial, the rectangle contained by them medial, and further the sum of the squares on them incommensurable with the rectangle contained by them. [[X. 78](/principles/euclid-10-78)]
BE是AB附件,同样工程也进行;因此,正方形的AE是正方形直线不可公度,中项无理线段是矩形直线,中项无理线段是矩形直线,中项无理线段是正方形直线正方形,不可公度直线不可公度直线不可公度是正方形直线正方形直线。（相关点与线段：EB） [[X. 78](/principles/euclid-10-78)]

Now, as was proved, AE, EB are commensurable with CF, FD, the sum of the squares on AE, EB with the sum of the squares on CF, FD, and the rectangle AE, EB with the rectangle CF, FD; therefore CF, FD are also straight lines incommensurable in square which make the sum of the squares on them medial, the rectangle contained by them medial, and further the sum of the squares on them incommensurable with the rectangle contained by them.
事实证明,现在AE,EB是可公度,CF,FD,和EB,正方形和CF,FD和矩形,AE和EB,矩形,CF和EB,CF,FD也是正方形的直线不可公度,中项无理线段和矩形,中项无理线段,正方形和矩形,不可公度和不可公度,不可公度和矩形。
Therefore CD is a straight line which produces with a medial area a medial whole. [[X. 78](/principles/euclid-10-78)]
因此,CD是一条直线,中项无理线段个区域中项无理线段个整条线。 [[X. 78](/principles/euclid-10-78)]
